prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 26 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1321; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and was seen for cervical strain with associated muscle spasm, pain rated 6 of 10 at initial evaluation, and reduced range of motion in rotation and lateral flexion. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no radicular symptoms, numbness, or weakness reported. Imaging was not indicated at the time of initial assessment given the absence of red-flag findings.

Care consisted of a structured course of 26 visits over the treatment period, including manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, therapeutic exercise for deep cervical flexor and scapular stabilization, and home exercise instruction. Modalities such as heat and electrical stimulation were used early for symptom control and were tapered as tolerance improved.

Over the course of care, the patient's pain decreased steadily to 2 of 10, cervical range of motion approached functional norms, and headache frequency diminished. Mild intermittent stiffness persists with prolonged computer use. The patient has been discharged to an independent home program with instructions to return if symptoms worsen or new neurological signs develop. Work restrictions were lifted at the end of active care.
